Klasse AVLTree<A>

java.lang.Object
org.quurz.foomp.base.util.AVLTree<A>
Typparameter:
A - the type of elements maintained by this tree
Alle implementierten Schnittstellen:
BinaryTree<A>, Echo, Mergeable<BinaryTree<A>>, Transmogrifyable<AVLTree<A>>, Tree<A>, Visitable<Tree<A>>
Bekannte direkte Unterklassen:
AVLTree.Leaf, AVLTree.Node
public abstract sealed class AVLTree<A> extends Object implements BinaryTree<A>, Transmogrifyable<AVLTree<A>>, Echo permits AVLTree.Node<A>, AVLTree.Leaf<A>

An implementation of a self-balancing binary search tree (AVL tree).

    • equals

      public boolean equals(Object other)

      Compares the specified object with this tree for equality.

      Two AVL trees are considered equal if they contain the same elements in the same order (in-order traversal). The internal structure (balancing) of the trees may differ.

      Setzt außer Kraft:
      equals in Klasse Object
      Parameter:
      other - the object to be compared for equality with this tree
      Gibt zurück:
      true if the specified object is equal to this tree, false otherwise
      Seit:
      1.0.0

      public String toString()

      The representation follows the format Node(left, element, right) for nodes and Leaf() for leaves, providing a structural view of the tree.
